admission.justification: The template gives the writer request needed to resolve a conflicted dependent without submitting the crossing as an ordinary leaf write.

applicability: The Curator handoff ingestion template for a dependent changed on both sides of a master merge.
conditions: The master has an open crossing and the Curator can identify the existing dependent and its resolved links.
exclusions: Leaf ingestion has its own persisted worklist.

evidence: W2 code-to-reference comparison and instruction renewal.
handoff.path: L26 W3 invariant and onboarding judgments

statement: The Curator template names the crossing owner, the writer request for a conflicted dependent and every accepted record kind.
